uplink.note: No mast within 25 km carries a Vodacom operator tag in public data. Candidate uplink = nearest mapped communication mast; the Vodacom site is to be confirmed with Duane Forlee before design.

today: Four lodges (Great Fish River Lodge, Ecca Lodge, Melton Manor, Uplands Homestead), Heatherton Towers, an airstrip and at least ten other building groups on one reserve
The Great Fish River runs about 30 km through the property and almost divides it in half
Security (TFT Security) and the environmental team are already part of this conversation
No reserve-wide network is described for rangers, gates or cameras
context: Kwandwe runs four lodges, a security operation and an environmental team across a property split by the Great Fish River valley. Lodges on the valley side rarely see each other directly. One owned backbone on the ridges can reach all of them, the gates and the field, on a network the reserve controls.
security_note: Kwandwe is a Big Five reserve with rhino, and its security contractor is part of this discussion. A backbone that reaches the lodges, gates and ranger areas carries cameras, radio and alarms on one monitored network, day and night.
units_source: Published lodge listings (siyabona.com, expertafrica.com, travelbutlers.com): Great Fish River Lodge 9 suites, Ecca Lodge 6 suites, Melton Manor 4 suites, Uplands Homestead 3 bedrooms. Sep 2026
